blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Light Rail Transit (LRT) Line 2 is on a limited operation basis after lightning struck and severed a catenary wire at the Antipolo Station on Tuesday afternoon, the Light Rail Transit Authority (LRTA) announced. In an advisory, the LRTA said that train operations are temporarily limited between Recto Station and Santolan Station and vice versa, as of 3:40 p.m. It reported that lightning had cut the catenary wire at Antipolo Station at around 3 p.m. “Manatiling nakasubaybay sa aming official social media pages para sa mga susunod na abiso at mahahalagang impormasyon hinggil sa operasyon ng LRT […]...
